categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment realization, advancing the softgoal to maximize timely fine revenue and helping minimize administrative and enforcement cost, judged against time-to-closure indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=12. Supported by frequent variants like V0002 and V0004 where payment successfully closes the fine case.

categories.name: Merged resolution
categories.description: Resolution via merged tasks (id=13), helping maximize timely fine revenue while hurting administrative cost and preserving due-process rights.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=13. Represented in cases leading to credit collection and direct case completions.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution path involving administrative appeals submitted to the Prefecture, advancing the offender's due-process rights while potentially increasing administrative costs and reducing timely revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=14. Evidenced in variants involving 'Insert Date Appeal to Prefecture', 'Send Appeal to Prefecture', and subsequent prefecture responses.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution path involving judicial appeals to the Judge, making a strong positive contribution to preserving the offender's due-process rights while hurting administrative costs and timely revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=19. Evidenced in variants containing 'Appeal to Judge' activities.
